instructions: Zotero is the user's reference manager: their library of papers, books and other sources, with PDFs and other files, annotations, notes, collections and tags. Use these tools to find and read the user's sources, cite them in a citation style, add or organize items in their library, import and export them, and show them to the user in Zotero's windows. They work on the Zotero app on the user's computer, which is started if it isn't running. Tools that change the library ask the user for permission in Zotero unless they already granted it, and each such call is one step the user can undo with Edit → Undo, which moves anything added to the trash.

tools.name: zotero_status
tools.title: Zotero status
tools.description: Check that Zotero is reachable, and get its version, the libraries (with their libraryIDs) and the permissions the user has granted this app. Call this when other Zotero tools fail, to tell the user what's wrong.

client.description: The name this app gave Zotero

until.description: When the permission ends, or null for never

tools.name: zotero_search
tools.title: Search Zotero
tools.description:
Find items in a Zotero library the way Zotero's search box does. A query is free text, which matches according to mode, and clauses, which filter:
- By field: by:smith, year:2020, year:2015-2020, after:2019, before:2021, in:Nature (the publication), type:book, tag:"to read", abstract:crispr, fulltext:crispr (the files' text), added:2024, `added in the last 7 days`. Any other field by its name: doi:10.1038, `title starts with grounded`, `citation key:smith2020`.
- Empty or missing: `no` before a field or a kind of child finds items without it, and `has` items with it: `no doi`, `has abstract`, `no tags`, `no attachments`, `no notes`, `has annotations`.
- Counts: `number of notes > 2`.
- Annotations: type:annotation, color:yellow, `annotation comment:unclear`.
Join clauses with and or or, and group them with parentheses: `tag:review and (year:2020 or year:2021)`. Matches in notes, attachments and annotations return the item they belong to, unless the query is type:note, type:attachment or type:annotation.

query.description: Empty lists all items in the scope

mode.description: What free text matches: title, creators and year; all fields, tags and notes; or those and attachment full text

collectionKey.description: Only items in this collection. Not with savedSearchKey.

includeSubcollectionItems.description: Also items in the collection's subcollections, at any depth

savedSearchKey.description: Only items this saved search finds. Not with collectionKey.

sortDirection.description: Defaults to newest first for dates, A to Z otherwise

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more results

tools.name: zotero_get_items
tools.title: Get Zotero items
tools.description: Get the full data of items, in Zotero web API JSON, with their attachments and notes.

includeTrashed.description: Also get items in the trash, which have deleted: true

items.description: The item's fields, creators, tags, collections and so on, plus these

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

missing.description: Keys with no item, or of items in the trash without includeTrashed

tools.name: zotero_list_collections
tools.title: List Zotero collections
tools.description: List a library's collections, or a collection's subcollections at any depth, with how many items each has. To list a collection's items, use zotero_search with collectionKey.

includeSubcollectionItems.description: Count the items in each collection's subcollections too

itemCount.description: Top-level items in the collection, and in its subcollections with includeSubcollectionItems

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the collection in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_list_tags
tools.title: List Zotero tags
tools.description: List a library's tags with how many items have each. Colored tags, which the user assigned to number keys, come first.

color.description: red, orange, gray, green, teal, blue, indigo, purple or plum, or #rrggbb if it isn't one of the colors Zotero offers

tools.name: zotero_list_saved_searches
tools.title: List Zotero saved searches
tools.description: List a library's saved searches, with their conditions. Get the items one finds, and how many, with zotero_search's savedSearchKey; show it to the user with zotero_select's savedSearchKey.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows it in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_list_item_types
tools.title: List Zotero item types
tools.description: List the item types an item can be (book, journalArticle and so on), with each type's fields and creator types, by the names zotero_add_items, zotero_update_items and zotero_change_item_types take.

label.description: The name Zotero shows the user, in Zotero's language

fields.description: In the order the item pane shows them

baseField.description: The general field this type's field stands for, e.g. publicationTitle for bookTitle. A type change moves a value between fields with the same base field, and zotero_update_items also takes the base field's name.

primary.description: The type's main creator type, e.g. author

tools.name: zotero_search_fulltext
tools.title: Search Zotero full text
tools.description: Find where words or phrases occur in the text of PDFs, EPUBs, web page snapshots and other files in a Zotero library, and get the passage around each match, with its page and a link that opens the file there. Matches words, not meaning: every word or "quoted phrase" in the query must occur in a file, ignoring case and accents, and a word also matches words it starts ("archive" matches "archives"). Only files Zotero has indexed are searched, and by default only the first 100 pages of a PDF. Files are listed by when their item was last modified, not by relevance. Use zotero_read_text to read more around a passage, and zotero_search with fulltext: to combine full text with other criteria.

query.description: Words and "quoted phrases", e.g. 'carbon "soil organic matter"'

itemKeys.description: Only these items' files, given by item or attachment keys. Not with collectionKey.

collectionKey.description: Only the files of items in this collection

includeSubcollectionItems.description: Also items in the collection's subcollections, at any depth

parentKey.description: The key of the item it belongs to

pending.description: Zotero is still getting the file's text, so its passages are missing

passages.description: Passages with the most query terms first

page.description: PDF page, from 1, for zotero_read_text and links

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing, when Zotero has it

offset.description: Character offset in a file without pages, for zotero_read_text

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

nextOffset.description: Present when there are more files

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_read_text
tools.title: Read text from a Zotero file
tools.description: Read the text of a PDF, EPUB, web page snapshot or text file in Zotero. PDFs are read by page, with page labels (the page numbers printed on the pages, for citing) and the outline when Zotero has them; other files by character offset. Returns about maxChars characters per call, and nextPage or nextOffset to continue.

itemKey.description: An attachment's key, or an item's key for its best file

startPage.description: PDF page to start at, from 1. Defaults to 1.

offset.description: Character offset to start at, for files without pages

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page

nextPage.description: Present when there are more pages in the range

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_get_notes
tools.title: Get Zotero notes and annotations
tools.description: Get notes and annotations (highlights, underlines, comments and so on made in Zotero's reader). For an item, returns its notes and the annotations in its files; for an attachment, its annotations; or give note or annotation keys. Image and ink annotations (areas or drawings the user marked) have an imagePath once Zotero has rendered them; get the others' with zotero_render_annotation_images. Images in notes show as [image] in Markdown, and come in images in the same order, with their files.

itemKeys.description: Item, attachment, note or annotation keys

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

images.description: Images in the note, in order

path.description: The image file, if it's on this computer

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file at the annotation

imagePath.description: For an image or ink annotation Zotero has rendered, a PNG of it. Read it now rather than keep the path: Zotero replaces the file when the annotation changes.

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

tools.name: zotero_render_annotation_images
tools.title: Render Zotero annotation images
tools.description: Get PNG files of image and ink annotations in PDFs (areas or drawings the user marked), rendering the ones Zotero hasn't rendered yet. Use it for annotations zotero_get_notes gives no imagePath for, e.g. to see a figure the user marked. Rendering can outlast the call.

path.description: A PNG. Read it now rather than keep the path: Zotero replaces it when the annotation changes.

status.description: pending: Zotero is still rendering it

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_get_context
tools.title: Get what the user is looking at in Zotero
tools.description: Get the active window's selection and reader or note, plus tab IDs for all windows. A tab ID is unique only within its window (each window's first library tab is zotero-pane): give its windowID too when it's in several.

window.description: Whether a Zotero window is open. The rest describes the one the user used last.

tabType.description: The active tab's kind: library, reader, note or another kind

libraryTabID.description: The library tab the selection below is from: the active one, or the one used last

libraryID.description: The library selected in the library tab

selectedItems.description: Items selected in the library tab, at most 50

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

reader.description: The file open in the active reader tab

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

page.description: PDF page the user is on, from 1

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on that page, for citing

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file, at the page for a PDF

note.description: The note open in the active note tab

current.description: The window the user used last

type.description: library, reader, note or another kind

key.description: The file or note a reader or note tab shows

page.description: PDF page a reader tab is on, from 1

collectionKey.description: The collection a library tab shows

savedSearchKey.description: The saved search a library tab shows

tools.name: zotero_select
tools.title: Show items in Zotero
tools.description: Show a library, collection or saved search in a Zotero library tab, with the given items, or all of its items, selected, so the user can see them. Replaces what the tab shows, including any search or tag filter. Opens Zotero's window if none is open. Changes only what Zotero shows, not the library.

collectionKey.description: Defaults to the whole library. Not with savedSearchKey.

itemKeys.description: Items to select. Only items in the collection or saved search can be selected. Without itemKeys or allItems, nothing is selected, even if the collection was already shown with a selection.

allItems.description: Select every item shown. Not with itemKeys.

windowID.description: A window from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window the user used last.

tabID.description: A library tab from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window's library tab used last.

newTab.description: Show them in a new library tab

newWindow.description: Show them in a new window

focus.description: Bring Zotero to the front. By default it stays behind the app the user is in.

notShown.description: Items that aren't in the collection or saved search, so weren't selected

missing.description: Keys that don't exist or are in the trash

tools.name: zotero_open
tools.title: Open a file or note in Zotero
tools.description: Open a PDF, EPUB or web page snapshot in Zotero's reader, or a note, for the user to see, and scroll the reader to a page or an annotation. If it's already open, its tab is selected and scrolled instead, unless newTab is given. Changes only what Zotero shows, not the library.

itemKey.description: An attachment, a note, or a regular item to open its PDF, EPUB or snapshot

page.description: PDF page to scroll to, from 1, as zotero_read_text and zotero_search_fulltext give. Only one of page, pageLabel and annotationKey.

pageLabel.description: The page number printed on the page, for a PDF or an EPUB with page numbers

annotationKey.description: An annotation of the file to scroll to and select

windowID.description: A window from zotero_get_context. Defaults to the window the user used last.

newTab.description: Open another tab even if it's already open

newWindow.description: Open it in a new window, even if it's open in another

focus.description: Bring Zotero to the front. By default it stays behind the app the user is in.

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_close
tools.title: Close Zotero tabs or windows
tools.description: Close tabs and windows by their IDs from zotero_get_context. The user can reopen them with Zotero's Reopen Closed Tab. Pinned tabs, and Zotero's last tab outside macOS, can't be closed.

windowID.description: The window of tabIDs, needed when one of them is in several windows

windowIDs.description: Windows to close, with all their tabs

tools.name: zotero_generate_citation
tools.title: Generate Zotero citations
tools.description: Format items in a citation style: as one citation (with page or other locators), as a bibliography, or, with format document, all of a document's citations at once. Use format document when writing a document with several citations: give its citations in the order they appear, and get each one formatted and the bibliography, with numbering, disambiguation (Smith 2020a, 2020b) and ibid. or short forms worked out across the document. A citation formatted on its own always starts at [1] in a numeric style. For BibTeX, RIS and other export formats, use zotero_export. A style that isn't installed is installed from the Zotero Style Repository if the user allows it.

items.description: For format citation or bibliography, in citation order

citations.description: For format document: the document's citations in the order they appear, each the items cited together in one place

style.description: A style's short name, e.g. "apa", or its ID

locale.description: e.g. "en-GB". Defaults to the language Zotero is in.

citations.description: For format document, each citation in the order given

bibliography.description: For format document. Empty for a style without one.

noteStyle.description: For format document: whether the style puts citations in footnotes, one footnote per citation

tools.name: zotero_update_items
tools.title: Edit Zotero items
tools.description: Change items' metadata, tags and collections: set or clear fields (title, date, DOI, abstractNote and so on), replace creators, add or remove tags, and add items to or remove them from collections. To change an item's type, use zotero_change_item_types. All or nothing: one invalid change fails the call.

fields.description: Fields to set, by Zotero field name (zotero_list_item_types lists each item type's), e.g. {"title": "…", "date": "2020-05"}. An empty string clears a field.

creators.description: Replaces all of the item's creators, in order

creatorType.description: e.g. "author" or "editor"; zotero_list_item_types lists each item type's

name.description: Instead of firstName and lastName, for an organization or a one-part name

addToCollections.description: Collection keys. An item stays in the collections it's already in.

removeFromCollections.description: Collection keys. The item stays in the library.

items.description: The items as they are now

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_change_item_types
tools.title: Change Zotero item types
tools.description: Change items' types, e.g. from journalArticle to bookSection. Fields the new type also has keep their values. A field with a counterpart in the new type moves to it (e.g. publicationTitle becomes bookTitle; zotero_list_item_types lists each field's baseField). Fields the new type doesn't have are removed, and the result gives their values, so you can tell the user or put them elsewhere. Use zotero_update_items afterwards to fill the new type's fields. Notes, attachments and annotations can't change type. All or nothing: one invalid change fails the call.

items.description: The items as they are now, with what the change did to them

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

movedFields.description: Old field → the new type's field its value moved to

removedFields.description: Old field → the value it had, which the item no longer has

tools.name: zotero_manage_collections
tools.title: Create, rename or move a Zotero collection
tools.description: Create a collection, rename one, or move one into another collection or to the top level. To put items in a collection, use zotero_update_items. To delete one, use zotero_trash.

parentKey.description: The collection to create or move it in, or null to move it to the top level. For create, defaults to the top level; for update, to where it is.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the collection in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_manage_saved_searches
tools.title: Manage Zotero saved searches
tools.description: Create a saved search, or rename one or change its query. The query uses zotero_search's syntax. To delete one, use zotero_trash.

query.description: Needed for create. As for zotero_search, e.g. `tag:"to read" no notes`

mode.description: How free text in the query matches, as for zotero_search

link.description: zotero:// link that shows it in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_add_note
tools.title: Add a Zotero note
tools.description: Add a note, written in Markdown, under an item (a child note) or as a standalone note, optionally in a collection. Supports CommonMark with tables, ~~strikethrough~~ and TeX math: $…$ inline, and display math between lines of just $$. As when Markdown is pasted into a Zotero note, dollar signs only become math around something that looks like math (a TeX command, braces or an operator), so $x$ alone or $5 stays text. Raw HTML is shown as text, and images become links.

markdown.description: The note. Its first line becomes its title, so start with a heading.

parentKey.description: The regular item (e.g. a journal article) to add the note under

collectionKey.description: For a standalone note, a collection to put it in

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_manage_tags
tools.title: Manage Zotero tags
tools.description: Change tags across a whole library: rename a tag, merge several into one by renaming them all to the same name (which may be an existing tag), delete tags from every item that has them, or set or remove a tag's color. Tag names match exactly, including case, as zotero_list_tags lists them. To change the tags of particular items, use zotero_update_items. Color changes can't be undone.

color.description: For setColor: one of the colors Zotero offers, or null to remove the color. Leave it out to keep the tag's color, e.g. to give it another position. Colored tags show first in the tag selector and as colored dots on items; at most 9 tags can have colors.

position.description: For setColor: the number key that toggles the tag on selected items. Defaults to its current one, or the next free one.

itemCount.description: For rename and delete, the items changed

color.description: For setColor: the color's name, or its #rrggbb value if it isn't one Zotero offers; absent if removed

tools.name: zotero_edit_note
tools.title: Edit a Zotero note
tools.description: Add Markdown to the end of a note, or replace its content, with the same Markdown as zotero_add_note. Give the note's dateModified from zotero_get_notes: if the note changed since, e.g. because the user edited it, nothing is changed and you get it again first. Replacing works only on notes without highlights, citations or images, which Markdown can't hold; append to the others.

mode.description: replace: the Markdown becomes the whole note, and its first line the note's title

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the note in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_list_duplicates
tools.title: List duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: List the sets of items Zotero considers duplicates, as its Duplicate Items view does: items with the same DOI or ISBN, or with similar titles, the same creators and years close together. Check that a set really is one work, e.g. not a preprint and its published version the user keeps apart, before merging it with zotero_merge_items. Each set is oldest first.

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

tools.name: zotero_merge_items
tools.title: Merge duplicate Zotero items
tools.description: Merge items that are the same work, as Zotero's merge button does: the master item keeps its own fields and gets the others' notes, files, annotations, tags, collections and related items, and the others go to the trash. Duplicate PDFs are combined, keeping the annotations of each. To use a field value from another copy, set it on the master with zotero_update_items. The items must be regular items of the same type.

masterKey.description: The item to keep, one of itemKeys. Defaults to the oldest.

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the master item in Zotero

tools.name: zotero_trash
tools.title: Move to or restore from the Zotero trash
tools.description: Move items (with their notes and attachments), collections (with their subcollections) or saved searches to the trash, or restore them from it. Items in a trashed collection stay in the library. The user can restore them from the trash until it's emptied.

collectionKeys.description: Without subcollections of other collections given, which went with them

tools.name: zotero_add_items
tools.title: Add items to Zotero
tools.description:
Add items to a Zotero library, with their metadata looked up, and look for their PDFs. For BibTeX, RIS or another import format, use zotero_import. Ways to add, best first:
- identifiers: DOIs, ISBNs, arXiv IDs or PubMed IDs, or URLs that contain one (doi.org, a publisher's article page with the DOI in its URL, arxiv.org, pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Zotero doesn't add other web pages: the user saves those with the Zotero Connector in their browser.
- items: item JSON, for something without an identifier whose metadata you found yourself.
By default Zotero then looks for each new item's PDF or EPUB as its Find Full Text does, from the user's computer, so access through their institution works.

items.description: Item JSON in the Zotero web API format, as zotero_get_items returns, e.g. {"itemType": "report", "title": "…", "creators": [{"creatorType": "author", "firstName": "Ann", "lastName": "Lee"}], "date": "2024", "institution": "…", "url": "…"}. Only fields of the item type are accepted; zotero_list_item_types lists each type's fields and creator types. Notes and files aren't items here: add them with zotero_add_note and zotero_add_attachment.

collectionKey.description: A collection to add the items to

results.description: One per item, in the order given. An identifier can give several.

status.description: pending: Zotero is still looking up the identifier, and adds its item when it finds it.

attachments.description: The new item's attachments, e.g. the PDF Zotero found

fileSearch.description: For a new item without a file: whether Zotero is still looking for one

link.description: zotero:// link that shows the item in Zotero

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_find_fulltext_attachments
tools.title: Find full text in Zotero
tools.description: Look for a PDF or EPUB of items that have none, as Zotero's Find Full Text menu command does: by DOI, URL or PMCID, from open-access sources and from the publisher's site, through the user's institution where they have access. Use it for items added without files, e.g. by zotero_import. Items that already have a PDF or EPUB, or have no DOI, URL or PMCID, are skipped.

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_add_attachment
tools.title: Attach a file in Zotero
tools.description: Attach a local file, or download a PDF/EPUB to a parent item. Without a parent, Zotero adds a local file on its own and tries to identify it.

parentKey.description: The regular item (e.g. a journal article) to attach the file to. Omit to add a file from path as a standalone attachment that Zotero identifies.

url.description: http or https, with parentKey: a PDF or EPUB, or a page that links to one. Downloaded from the user's computer, so their institution's access applies. Not with path.

path.description: The absolute path of a file on this computer

linkFile.description: Link to the file at path where it is, instead of copying it into Zotero

collectionKey.description: Without parentKey, a collection to add the file and the item Zotero creates for it to

title.description: The attachment's title. By default Zotero names it, e.g. "Full Text PDF".

status.description: pending: Zotero is still downloading the file

identified.description: Without parentKey, whether Zotero identified the file and created its parent item. Absent while Zotero is still identifying it.

parent.description: The item Zotero created for the file

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

path.description: The file on this computer, to open it yourself, e.g. to look at a figure. Absent if the file isn't on this computer.

link.description: zotero:// link that opens the file in Zotero

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_import
tools.title: Import into Zotero
tools.description: Import a file on this computer, or text, in a format Zotero imports: BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, MODS, EndNote XML and others. Like File → Import, the PDFs and other files a file refers to are imported too, and a file's items go into a new collection named after it unless collectionKey is given. Zotero doesn't check whether the items are already in the library.

path.description: The file's absolute path. Not with text.

collectionKey.description: A collection to add the items to

newCollection.description: Put the items in a new collection. Defaults to true for a file and false for text.

linkFiles.description: Link to the files a file refers to where they are, instead of copying them into Zotero

collectionKey.description: The collection the items went into

bestAttachment.description: The attachment Zotero opens when the item is double-clicked: its PDF if it has one, or else its oldest file or snapshot

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next

tools.name: zotero_export
tools.title: Export from Zotero
tools.description: Export items, a collection, or a whole library, in an export format, as text or to a new file on this computer. Formats include BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, Zotero RDF, CSL JSON, CSV, MODS, EndNote XML and Markdown or HTML for notes; an unknown format gives the full list. Large exports must be written to a file.

format.description: An export format's name, e.g. "BibTeX" or "CSL JSON"

itemKeys.description: Items to export. Not with collectionKey. Without either, the whole library.

includeSubcollectionItems.description: Also the items in the collection's subcollections, at any depth. Formats that keep collections, such as Zotero RDF, then also export the subcollections.

path.description: An absolute path to write to, where nothing exists yet. Without it, the export is returned as text.

includeFiles.description: Also copy the items' files, with their annotations. path is then a new folder, with the export file inside it.

overwrite.description: Replace a file already at path. A folder, or an export with includeFiles, is never replaced.

output.description: The export, when no path was given

folder.description: The folder with the file and the items' files, for includeFiles

status.description: pending: Zotero is still writing the file

citationKeys.description: For BibTeX and BibLaTeX, of up to 500 items: the item keys of the regular items exported, each with its citation key in the export

notice.description: Present when the result is incomplete: why, and what to do next
